visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens outdoors in front of a coffee shop named Chen Yi Coffee. A main character, a man with a short haircut wearing a black T-shirt, holds a large, plush orange die with blue and red spots. To his left stands another man wearing a white T-shirt and a square cardboard mask with a cartoon face. They are standing on a paved sidewalk next to glass doors and a menu board. The man in the black T-shirt prepares to toss the die while looking directly at the camera with an expectant expression. (2) The masked man kicks the orange die across the sidewalk. The camera follows the motion of the die as it rolls and lands on the number one. There is a close-up of the man in the black T-shirt expressing mock disbelief, his mouth wide open. A variety of graphic overlays like motion lines and large text appear. (3) The setting shifts to the interior of a cafe with warm lighting, wooden wall panels, and a large black world map decoration. A man in a black baseball cap and black T-shirt smiles and speaks towards the camera, appearing energetic. The main character in the black T-shirt is then shown seated, preparing to eat. (4) A montage of food follows: a thick piece of toast topped with chocolate crumbles is held with chopsticks, then a bowl of braised pork rice (Kong Rou Fan) with bamboo shoots is shown in a close-up, followed by a bowl of stir-fried rice vermicelli. Various people are seen eating and giving thumbs-up. (5) The final phase transitions to a screen recording of a mobile app interface. It shows lists of restaurants and maps of Hualien. The man in the black T-shirt appears in a picture-in-picture or split-screen format, pointing upwards and smiling while promotional text about a 'Way Hualien' event and discount coupons floats across the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic male voice and a fast-paced, high-energy synth-pop background track. There is a distinct 'whoosh' transition sound as the dice are thrown, followed by a muffled 'thud' of the plush die hitting the pavement. (2) Multiple male voices erupt in laughter and short exclamations ('Eh!', 'Yi!'). The BGM continues steadily. A 'ding' sound effect highlights the text appearing on screen. (3) As the scene transitions to the food montage, the speaker's tone becomes appreciative and descriptive. Frequent 'pop' and 'cartoon' sound effects punctuate the visual cuts between different dishes. Faint crunching or slurping sounds are layered under the narration during the eating shots. (4) In the final segment, the voice becomes more instructional and promotional. High-frequency 'click' and digital notification sounds accompany the demonstration of the mobile app interface. The music swells slightly for the final call to action, maintaining its high-tempo, major-key brightness throughout.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a stamp collection and coupon event titled 'Way Hualien' organized by the Hualien County Government. It uses a comedic and high-energy food-vlog style to showcase local eateries and delicacies (the 'hook'), then transitions to explaining how to use the official app/map to find these shops and claim discount vouchers (the 'utility').

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of Hualien County Government, explicit promotional text for vouchers, and demonstration of a specific event app.
